title: 🗺️ Google Maps Now Plans Your Entire Trip with AI!
body: 🗺️ Google Maps Now Plans Your Entire Trip with AI!

Google Maps added a new feature that answers complex travel questions: ask it for a multi-day itinerary in a city, and it suggests places, routes, and restaurants available at the time you want, with live details about each stop. It can also search for available booking times, such as an appointment at the barber or a clinic, and may call the place on your behalf to book the appointment. The feature is rolling out gradually to phones, with some parts available in the US first, while the service expands to 30 new European countries.
Simply put: the map no longer just shows you the way — it plans your whole day.
Would you trust a travel plan made for you by AI?
